name: Saved progress triggers the resume modal and Continue restores it
description: After answering a question on the Solstice take page (which saves encrypted progress locally), visiting the Start page opens a resume modal that, on Continue, returns the user to the exact question they left off on.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Solstice take page
Click one of the seven numbered answer options to answer the first question
Verify the second question is now displayed and the progress indicator reads '2 of 36', confirming the first answer was recorded.
Click the 'Begin Your Arc' link in the site header to go to the Start page
Verify a 'Pick up where you left off?' resume modal opens that identifies Solstice and states '1 of 36 questions answered'.
Click the 'Continue' button in the resume modal
Verify the browser returns to the Solstice take page with the progress indicator reading '2 of 36', confirming the saved progress was restored to the second question.
